Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: What if you could sit front row at a Doja Cat concert without leaving your living room? The concert will premiere in VR on Saturday, January 20 at 5:00pm PT, in Meta Horizon Worlds’ Music Valley. Filmed at the sold-out Detroit stop of Doja Cat’s debut arena tour, this VR concert will feature Doja’s most popular songs from The Scarlet Tour including “Paint the Town Red,” “Agora Hills,” “Woman,” and more. The VR concert will be available exclusively in Meta Horizon Worlds’ Music Valley, which offers the ultimate musical festival experience in virtual reality. RSVP for the event , and if you’re unable to join on January 20, replays will be available for another couple weeks in Meta Horizon Worlds after the concert.
